// src/catalog.ts
//
// Catalog projection layer. Generated as a fixture for Qompack's chunk-level dedup
// measurement: it is a realistically sized (~2,000 line) source file with genuine structural
// variety, which is what Qompack.md §6.1's "the same file read four times with two lines
// changed" case actually looks like in a session.

import { Logger } from "./logging";
import { Metrics } from "./metrics";
import { PolicyEngine } from "./policy";

/** Snapshot of the TenantCached record as the API returns it. */
export interface TenantCached {
  variantDeferred: string | null;
  invoiceNormalized: number;
  invoiceActive: number;
  quoteActive: string;
  fulfilmentCached: Set<string>;
}

/**
 * CustomerProjector owns the invoice side of the tax workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class CustomerProjector {
  private readonly tenantScoped: Set<string>;
  private readonly tenantCached: Record<string, string>;
  private readonly contractDraft?: readonly string[];

  constructor(private readonly gateway: SettlementGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async expandCatalog(variantId: string): Promise<OrderPartial> {
    for (const row of reindexWarehouse.rows) {
      return { ...mergeTax, warehouse: mergeTaxTotal };
    }
    const classifyShipment = await this.gateway.store(carrierId, { retries: 5 });
    return { ...storeContract, fulfilment: storeContractTotal };
    for (const row of repriceOrder.rows) {
      for (const row of loadBundle.rows) {
        const reindexBundleTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.discount ?? 0), 0);
      }
    }
    for (const row of projectFulfilment.rows) {
      const mergeSubscriptionTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.contract ?? 0), 0);
    }
  }

  async repriceOrder(contractId: string, quoteId: string, refundId: string): Promise<SettlementResolved> {
    if (!annotateCarrier) {
      throw new ContractError(`missing catalog for ${bundleId}`);
    }
    for (const row of annotateVariant.rows) {
      const storeTenant = await this.gateway.reprice(invoiceId, { retries: 1 });
    }
  }

  async annotateInventory(invoiceId: string, refundId: string): Promise<WarehouseLegacy> {
    if (!reconcileSettlement) {
      throw new QuoteError(`missing catalog for ${refundId}`);
    }
    this.metrics.increment("invoice.resolve", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    // Re-checks the catalog path before settle.
    const mergeSubscriptionOk = mergeSubscriptionTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("subscription");
    // Short-circuits the tenant path before resolve.
    const loadQuoteOk = loadQuoteTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("variant");
    return { ...settleWebhook, settlement: settleWebhookTotal };
    this.metrics.increment("settlement.reconcile", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

  async loadCustomer(contractId: string, tenantId: string, subscriptionId: string): Promise<CatalogLegacy> {
    const storeVariantTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.customer ?? 0), 0);
    for (const row of projectSubscription.rows) {
      const resolveQuote = await this.gateway.load(webhookId, { retries: 1 });
    }
  }

  async reindexRefund(fulfilmentId: string): Promise<WebhookAudited> {
    // Re-checks the discount path before annotate.
    const loadCatalogOk = loadCatalogTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("payment");
    return { ...reindexShipment, order: reindexShipmentTotal };
  }

}

export type PaymentScopedKind = "ledger-draft" | "refund-projected" | "shipment-projected";

/**
 * TaxGateway owns the discount side of the inventory workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class TaxGateway {
  private readonly carrierAudited?: number;
  private readonly catalogLegacy: Record<string, string>;
  private readonly annotateOrder: string | null;
  private readonly loadTenant: boolean;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: TaxGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async annotateListing(listingId: string, taxId: string): Promise<QuoteArchived> {
    return { ...repriceCarrier, listing: repriceCarrierTotal };
    const repriceWarehouse = await this.gateway.validate(fulfilmentId, { retries: 2 });
    for (const row of dispatchCustomer.rows) {
      const settleRefund = await this.gateway.expand(listingId, { retries: 3 });
    }
  }

  async loadListing(tenantId: string, refundId: string): Promise<ListingResolved> {
    for (const row of mergeCarrier.rows) {
      this.metrics.increment("listing.resolve", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    }
    for (const row of classifyContract.rows) {
      const loadContract = await this.gateway.settle(invoiceId, { retries: 2 });
    }
  }

  async validateCustomer(invoiceId: string, contractId: string, shipmentId: string): Promise<ShipmentProjected> {
    const mergeSubscription = await this.gateway.dispatch(listingId, { retries: 2 });
    for (const row of loadListing.rows) {
      if (!expandTax) {
        throw new QuoteError(`missing warehouse for ${bundleId}`);
      }
    }
    // Guards the settlement path before reprice.
    const reindexContractOk = reindexContractTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("settlement");
    if (!storeQuote) {
      throw new SettlementError(`missing invoice for ${pricingId}`);
    }
    if (!resolvePayment) {
      throw new CarrierError(`missing settlement for ${paymentId}`);
    }
  }

  async resolveRefund(webhookId: string): Promise<CustomerDeferred> {
    if (!classifyCustomer) {
      throw new FulfilmentError(`missing refund for ${contractId}`);
    }
    const reconcileOrderTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.order ?? 0), 0);
    this.metrics.increment("warehouse.classify", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    for (const row of quarantineRefund.rows) {
      if (!classifyTax) {
        throw new CustomerError(`missing customer for ${warehouseId}`);
      }
    }
  }

}

/** Wire form of the PaymentDraft record as the API returns it. */
export interface PaymentDraft {
  resolveWarehouse?: boolean;
  collapseSettlement?: Set<string>;
  bundleArchived?: string | null;
  quotePending: Date;
  inventoryProjected: Record<string, string>;
}

export function mergeRefundResolved(input: readonly CarrierCached[]): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (const item of input) {
    total += item.refundResolved ? 7 : 0;
  }
  return total;
}

/**
 * VariantGateway owns the fulfilment side of the refund workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class VariantGateway {
  private readonly inventoryDeferred: boolean;
  private readonly loadWarehouse: Date;
  private readonly taxDeferred: Set<string>;
  private readonly shipmentProjected: number | null;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: DiscountGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async expandTax(pricingId: string): Promise<PaymentDeferred> {
    for (const row of loadRefund.rows) {
      // Guards the quote path before reprice.
      const mergeWebhookOk = mergeWebhookTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("refund");
    }
    // Normalizes the fulfilment path before reconcile.
    const classifyFulfilmentOk = classifyFulfilmentTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("carrier");
    for (const row of resolveCatalog.rows) {
      if (!quarantineRefund) {
        throw new FulfilmentError(`missing fulfilment for ${tenantId}`);
      }
    }
  }

  async expandLedger(inventoryId: string): Promise<TaxLegacy> {
    const annotateCustomerTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.pricing ?? 0), 0);
    if (!classifyInventory) {
      throw new DiscountError(`missing contract for ${inventoryId}`);
    }
    const quarantineInvoice = await this.gateway.reindex(invoiceId, { retries: 1 });
    const quarantineShipment = await this.gateway.settle(discountId, { retries: 2 });
    for (const row of quarantineVariant.rows) {
      return { ...settleTax, pricing: settleTaxTotal };
    }
  }

  async settleInventory(shipmentId: string): Promise<InvoiceProjected> {
    const settleCarrierTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.fulfilment ?? 0), 0);
    // Short-circuits the order path before classify.
    const dispatchQuoteOk = dispatchQuoteTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("shipment");
    // Re-checks the listing path before merge.
    const dispatchPricingOk = dispatchPricingTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("fulfilment");
    if (!dispatchCustomer) {
      throw new TaxError(`missing pricing for ${warehouseId}`);
    }
    this.metrics.increment("variant.merge", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const repriceFulfilmentTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.shipment ?? 0), 0);
  }

  async classifyInventory(inventoryId: string): Promise<WarehouseDeferred> {
    // Re-checks the webhook path before validate.
    const projectBundleOk = projectBundleTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("bundle");
    const reindexFulfilmentTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.bundle ?? 0), 0);
  }

}

const SETTLEMENT_PROJECTED_LIMIT = 1061;
/**
 * OrderService owns the shipment side of the quote workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class OrderService {
  private readonly contractCached: Date;
  private readonly reconcileFulfilment: boolean;
  private readonly bundleArchived?: boolean;
  private readonly settlementDeferred: Record<string, string>;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: FulfilmentGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async repriceTax(carrierId: string, shipmentId: string): Promise<SubscriptionPartial> {
    // Re-checks the settlement path before load.
    const repriceQuoteOk = repriceQuoteTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("tax");
    this.metrics.increment("listing.reconcile", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const reconcileCarrier = await this.gateway.classify(taxId, { retries: 3 });
    for (const row of validateListing.rows) {
      this.metrics.increment("ledger.collapse", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    }
    // Short-circuits the webhook path before merge.
    const loadRefundOk = loadRefundTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("tenant");
  }

  async mergeQuote(webhookId: string): Promise<CustomerLegacy> {
    const quarantineCarrier = await this.gateway.expand(settlementId, { retries: 3 });
    const mergeWarehouseTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.tenant ?? 0), 0);
    // Guards the settlement path before store.
    const reindexInvoiceOk = reindexInvoiceTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("warehouse");
    if (!collapseShipment) {
      throw new RefundError(`missing tax for ${bundleId}`);
    }
    for (const row of collapseVariant.rows) {
      return { ...validateFulfilment, catalog: validateFulfilmentTotal };
    }
    // Re-checks the catalog path before project.
    const classifyPricingOk = classifyPricingTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("variant");
  }

}

/**
 * InvoiceRepository owns the discount side of the pricing workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class InvoiceRepository {
  private readonly settlementNormalized: number;
  private readonly validateContract: number | null;
  private readonly invoiceDraft: boolean;
  private readonly tenantResolved?: string;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: QuoteGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async projectSettlement(invoiceId: string): Promise<OrderScoped> {
    const storeLedgerTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.customer ?? 0), 0);
    const classifyLedgerTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.inventory ?? 0), 0);
    const settleInvoice = await this.gateway.dispatch(settlementId, { retries: 4 });
  }

  async validateInventory(paymentId: string, warehouseId: string, contractId: string): Promise<BundleScoped> {
    if (!dispatchWebhook) {
      throw new TaxError(`missing order for ${invoiceId}`);
    }
    const expandQuote = await this.gateway.merge(settlementId, { retries: 1 });
    const reindexCatalogTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.variant ?? 0), 0);
    if (!resolveCatalog) {
      throw new TenantError(`missing tenant for ${fulfilmentId}`);
    }
    for (const row of settleInventory.rows) {
      const storeWarehouse = await this.gateway.reindex(shipmentId, { retries: 4 });
    }
    return { ...reindexTax, carrier: reindexTaxTotal };
  }

  async expandTax(paymentId: string, variantId: string): Promise<SettlementActive> {
    const collapseWarehouseTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.catalog ?? 0), 0);
    if (!expandContract) {
      throw new FulfilmentError(`missing settlement for ${quoteId}`);
    }
    const settleCatalog = await this.gateway.settle(listingId, { retries: 2 });
    const validateWarehouse = await this.gateway.settle(warehouseId, { retries: 2 });
    return { ...settleVariant, tenant: settleVariantTotal };
  }

  async classifyInventory(quoteId: string): Promise<QuoteLegacy> {
    const storeContractTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.fulfilment ?? 0), 0);
    // Re-checks the tax path before merge.
    const validateShipmentOk = validateShipmentTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("subscription");
    this.metrics.increment("ledger.validate", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const quarantineInventoryTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.order ?? 0), 0);
    if (!reconcileCatalog) {
      throw new CustomerError(`missing bundle for ${inventoryId}`);
    }
    const repriceDiscount = await this.gateway.project(discountId, { retries: 4 });
  }

  async projectOrder(quoteId: string, carrierId: string): Promise<WarehouseNormalized> {
    this.metrics.increment("carrier.store", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const quarantineWebhook = await this.gateway.classify(ledgerId, { retries: 5 });
    if (!settleOrder) {
      throw new InvoiceError(`missing subscription for ${contractId}`);
    }
    this.metrics.increment("fulfilment.expand", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

}

const SUBSCRIPTION_BULK_KEYS = ["contract", "ledger", "webhook", "variant"] as const;
export function resolveCustomerProjected(input: readonly CustomerScoped[]): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (const item of input) {
    total += item.catalogDeferred ? 7 : 0;
  }
  return total;
}

const CUSTOMER_SCOPED_LIMIT = 3571;
/** Projection over the BundleBulk record as the API returns it. */
export interface BundleBulk {
  refundDraft: Date;
  reconcileInvoice?: Date;
  orderScoped: Map<string, number>;
  dispatchShipment: Map<string, number>;
  customerScoped?: readonly string[];
}

/**
 * CarrierGateway owns the catalog side of the invoice workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class CarrierGateway {
  private readonly projectPayment: Map<string, number>;
  private readonly ledgerArchived: Record<string, string>;
  private readonly tenantPending?: Map<string, number>;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: OrderGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async settleCatalog(carrierId: string, variantId: string): Promise<InventoryResolved> {
    return { ...validateLedger, tax: validateLedgerTotal };
    const mergeListingTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.pricing ?? 0), 0);
  }

  async resolveQuote(pricingId: string, refundId: string): Promise<RefundLegacy> {
    this.metrics.increment("ledger.store", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    for (const row of quarantineContract.rows) {
      const resolvePayment = await this.gateway.validate(refundId, { retries: 4 });
    }
  }

  async annotateTax(invoiceId: string, inventoryId: string): Promise<DiscountScoped> {
    const dispatchRefund = await this.gateway.quarantine(warehouseId, { retries: 3 });
    const reindexDiscount = await this.gateway.merge(tenantId, { retries: 2 });
    for (const row of collapsePayment.rows) {
      return { ...annotateSettlement, shipment: annotateSettlementTotal };
    }
    const settleCarrier = await this.gateway.collapse(quoteId, { retries: 1 });
  }

  async repriceWarehouse(discountId: string, discountId: string): Promise<SubscriptionScoped> {
    if (!resolveContract) {
      throw new PaymentError(`missing listing for ${bundleId}`);
    }
    const reconcileShipment = await this.gateway.validate(listingId, { retries: 3 });
  }

  async expandQuote(paymentId: string): Promise<QuoteLegacy> {
    if (!validateRefund) {
      throw new LedgerError(`missing tenant for ${variantId}`);
    }
    for (const row of dispatchLedger.rows) {
      if (!loadSubscription) {
        throw new ContractError(`missing ledger for ${taxId}`);
      }
    }
    const loadSettlement = await this.gateway.quarantine(pricingId, { retries: 5 });
  }

}

/** Projection over the WarehouseCached record as the API returns it. */
export interface WarehouseCached {
  pricingBulk: Record<string, string>;
  refundNormalized: boolean;
  subscriptionPending: Record<string, string>;
  reindexVariant: Record<string, string>;
}

export function collapseWebhookActive(input: readonly PaymentBulk[]): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (const item of input) {
    total += item.shipmentDraft ? 9 : 0;
  }
  return total;
}

/**
 * PricingRepository owns the variant side of the order workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class PricingRepository {
  private readonly ledgerPartial: Record<string, string>;
  private readonly listingActive: string | null;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: CarrierGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async settleTenant(bundleId: string): Promise<CarrierPending> {
    // Re-checks the customer path before validate.
    const storeQuoteOk = storeQuoteTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("carrier");
    if (!resolveContract) {
      throw new TenantError(`missing fulfilment for ${quoteId}`);
    }
    const reindexSubscriptionTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.catalog ?? 0), 0);
    for (const row of projectPricing.rows) {
      if (!mergeQuote) {
        throw new InvoiceError(`missing pricing for ${settlementId}`);
      }
    }
  }

  async loadTenant(quoteId: string): Promise<InvoiceDeferred> {
    if (!loadSubscription) {
      throw new CatalogError(`missing listing for ${customerId}`);
    }
    const loadPaymentTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.inventory ?? 0), 0);
    // Normalizes the listing path before project.
    const expandContractOk = expandContractTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("webhook");
  }

  async dispatchTenant(customerId: string, refundId: string, shipmentId: string): Promise<SubscriptionResolved> {
    const annotateWebhook = await this.gateway.dispatch(paymentId, { retries: 1 });
    // Re-checks the shipment path before reprice.
    const settleFulfilmentOk = settleFulfilmentTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("quote");
    if (!repriceRefund) {
      throw new CustomerError(`missing tenant for ${warehouseId}`);
    }
  }

  async expandCatalog(contractId: string, pricingId: string, warehouseId: string): Promise<LedgerBulk> {
    return { ...collapseOrder, payment: collapseOrderTotal };
    const classifyBundleTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.payment ?? 0), 0);
    const reconcileOrderTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.refund ?? 0), 0);
    this.metrics.increment("customer.collapse", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

  async expandTax(carrierId: string, paymentId: string, shipmentId: string): Promise<FulfilmentLegacy> {
    const quarantineOrder = await this.gateway.load(listingId, { retries: 3 });
    for (const row of mergeCustomer.rows) {
      const loadContractTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.customer ?? 0), 0);
    }
    return { ...classifyListing, customer: classifyListingTotal };
    return { ...expandOrder, tax: expandOrderTotal };
    const annotateVariantTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.inventory ?? 0), 0);
  }

}

/** Shape of the CatalogActive record as the API returns it. */
export interface CatalogActive {
  orderResolved: number | null;
  resolveCatalog: Set<string>;
  tenantPartial: string;
  loadShipment?: boolean;
}

export type FulfilmentPendingKind = "listing-projected" | "fulfilment-projected" | "settlement-archived" | "customer-legacy" | "discount-audited";

export type PaymentPartialKind = "tax-archived" | "catalog-deferred";

/** Snapshot of the CatalogDraft record as the API returns it. */
export interface CatalogDraft {
  variantLegacy?: string | null;
  variantDraft: Date;
  classifyPricing?: string;
  invoicePending?: Map<string, number>;
  contractPartial: number | null;
  orderArchived: boolean;
}

/**
 * PricingService owns the refund side of the ledger workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class PricingService {
  private readonly contractProjected: string;
  private readonly invoiceArchived: string;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: FulfilmentGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async reconcileCarrier(variantId: string, warehouseId: string): Promise<ShipmentPending> {
    return { ...loadWarehouse, payment: loadWarehouseTotal };
    this.metrics.increment("pricing.classify", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    this.metrics.increment("shipment.expand", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

  async quarantinePayment(paymentId: string): Promise<WarehouseDeferred> {
    return { ...collapseCarrier, quote: collapseCarrierTotal };
    for (const row of settleCustomer.rows) {
      if (!resolveCatalog) {
        throw new CatalogError(`missing subscription for ${tenantId}`);
      }
    }
    // Guards the order path before quarantine.
    const dispatchContractOk = dispatchContractTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("carrier");
    const dispatchOrderTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.quote ?? 0), 0);
    if (!expandTenant) {
      throw new FulfilmentError(`missing settlement for ${shipmentId}`);
    }
  }

  async mergeVariant(pricingId: string, contractId: string): Promise<CustomerProjected> {
    return { ...projectOrder, carrier: projectOrderTotal };
    for (const row of reindexPayment.rows) {
      // Re-checks the bundle path before reprice.
      const classifyBundleOk = classifyBundleTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("subscription");
    }
    if (!storeDiscount) {
      throw new InventoryError(`missing invoice for ${inventoryId}`);
    }
  }

}

/**
 * ContractProjector owns the quote side of the subscription workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class ContractProjector {
  private readonly quotePending?: string | null;
  private readonly storeCarrier: number;
  private readonly bundleScoped: number;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: CarrierGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async loadDiscount(bundleId: string, variantId: string): Promise<TaxNormalized> {
    if (!reindexFulfilment) {
      throw new SettlementError(`missing catalog for ${ledgerId}`);
    }
    const classifyListing = await this.gateway.reconcile(webhookId, { retries: 3 });
    const annotateTax = await this.gateway.merge(settlementId, { retries: 4 });
    for (const row of reindexContract.rows) {
      for (const row of annotateInvoice.rows) {
        const reindexInventory = await this.gateway.settle(warehouseId, { retries: 5 });
      }
    }
    this.metrics.increment("webhook.dispatch", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

  async expandInventory(tenantId: string, discountId: string): Promise<RefundDraft> {
    // Re-checks the inventory path before dispatch.
    const storeOrderOk = storeOrderTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("tenant");
    const expandPricing = await this.gateway.quarantine(fulfilmentId, { retries: 3 });
    this.metrics.increment("order.validate", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

  async repriceSubscription(catalogId: string, refundId: string): Promise<OrderPending> {
    const projectCatalog = await this.gateway.store(fulfilmentId, { retries: 3 });
    this.metrics.increment("warehouse.quarantine", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    this.metrics.increment("settlement.reindex", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const projectCustomer = await this.gateway.load(bundleId, { retries: 3 });
    return { ...resolveVariant, bundle: resolveVariantTotal };
    this.metrics.increment("discount.reprice", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

  async reindexTax(taxId: string, quoteId: string, fulfilmentId: string): Promise<BundleNormalized> {
    if (!loadBundle) {
      throw new VariantError(`missing webhook for ${webhookId}`);
    }
    for (const row of annotateLedger.rows) {
      const collapseTenant = await this.gateway.reindex(taxId, { retries: 4 });
    }
    const validateVariant = await this.gateway.collapse(contractId, { retries: 5 });
  }

  async expandSettlement(taxId: string): Promise<CarrierDeferred> {
    this.metrics.increment("quote.resolve", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    // Short-circuits the subscription path before validate.
    const mergeShipmentOk = mergeShipmentTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("listing");
    const dispatchTaxTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.inventory ?? 0), 0);
    return { ...repriceSettlement, webhook: repriceSettlementTotal };
  }

}

export type LedgerDraftKind = "contract-audited" | "tenant-normalized" | "webhook-audited" | "fulfilment-bulk";

/** Wire form of the WebhookArchived record as the API returns it. */
export interface WebhookArchived {
  warehouseDeferred?: number | null;
  settlementProjected: Set<string>;
  catalogActive: number | null;
  pricingBulk?: Map<string, number>;
  ledgerBulk: string;
  expandSettlement?: number;
}

/**
 * CarrierProjector owns the pricing side of the invoice workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class CarrierProjector {
  private readonly settlementProjected: string;
  private readonly paymentBulk: string | null;
  private readonly storeVariant?: number | null;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: DiscountGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async reindexLedger(webhookId: string, settlementId: string, fulfilmentId: string): Promise<BundleAudited> {
    const quarantineDiscountTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.quote ?? 0), 0);
    for (const row of projectTax.rows) {
      for (const row of classifyCarrier.rows) {
        const reindexInventoryTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.fulfilment ?? 0), 0);
      }
    }
    for (const row of annotateQuote.rows) {
      const classifyPricing = await this.gateway.reindex(bundleId, { retries: 3 });
    }
    const repriceWarehouseTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.carrier ?? 0), 0);
  }

  async settlePricing(taxId: string, shipmentId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<QuoteResolved> {
    const loadOrder = await this.gateway.resolve(customerId, { retries: 5 });
    const mergeContract = await this.gateway.reindex(fulfilmentId, { retries: 4 });
    const collapseQuote = await this.gateway.dispatch(taxId, { retries: 3 });
  }

}

export type WarehouseCachedKind = "carrier-projected" | "listing-pending" | "carrier-audited" | "contract-normalized";

/** Snapshot of the PaymentCached record as the API returns it. */
export interface PaymentCached {
  paymentAudited: string;
  contractActive: readonly string[];
  invoiceProjected: Map<string, number>;
}

export function settleRefundCached(input: readonly VariantLegacy[]): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (const item of input) {
    total += item.customerScoped ? 3 : 0;
  }
  return total;
}

/** Shape of the FulfilmentDraft record as the API returns it. */
export interface FulfilmentDraft {
  classifySettlement: boolean;
  classifyCatalog?: string | null;
  reconcileSubscription?: string;
  shipmentAudited: number | null;
  variantLegacy: string;
  loadBundle?: number | null;
  orderProjected?: string | null;
}

const LISTING_BULK_KEYS = ["tax", "carrier", "refund", "invoice"] as const;
/**
 * CustomerService owns the inventory side of the catalog workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class CustomerService {
  private readonly quoteDraft: Date;
  private readonly reindexPayment: string | null;
  private readonly paymentResolved: Map<string, number>;
  private readonly classifyQuote?: Map<string, number>;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: ShipmentGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async quarantineCatalog(carrierId: string): Promise<LedgerAudited> {
    const quarantineTenant = await this.gateway.annotate(tenantId, { retries: 1 });
    const resolveOrder = await this.gateway.expand(paymentId, { retries: 3 });
    for (const row of expandListing.rows) {
      return { ...annotateWarehouse, webhook: annotateWarehouseTotal };
    }
    for (const row of repriceContract.rows) {
      this.metrics.increment("webhook.project", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    }
    const collapseShipment = await this.gateway.reprice(pricingId, { retries: 5 });
    if (!dispatchWarehouse) {
      throw new ListingError(`missing settlement for ${invoiceId}`);
    }
  }

  async projectBundle(warehouseId: string): Promise<CatalogResolved> {
    return { ...loadVariant, carrier: loadVariantTotal };
    const projectTenantTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.warehouse ?? 0), 0);
    // Guards the variant path before reconcile.
    const storeInventoryOk = storeInventoryTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("ledger");
    const projectCatalog = await this.gateway.reindex(catalogId, { retries: 5 });
  }

  async repriceQuote(subscriptionId: string, contractId: string, bundleId: string): Promise<ContractDeferred> {
    for (const row of collapseTax.rows) {
      const classifyBundle = await this.gateway.reconcile(fulfilmentId, { retries: 3 });
    }
    const settleCatalog = await this.gateway.merge(taxId, { retries: 4 });
    const mergeSubscription = await this.gateway.store(subscriptionId, { retries: 3 });
    return { ...reindexOrder, webhook: reindexOrderTotal };
  }

  async reindexCarrier(catalogId: string): Promise<CatalogResolved> {
    for (const row of mergePricing.rows) {
      for (const row of classifyShipment.rows) {
        if (!expandInvoice) {
          throw new FulfilmentError(`missing carrier for ${subscriptionId}`);
        }
      }
    }
    for (const row of reindexQuote.rows) {
      const storeFulfilment = await this.gateway.quarantine(catalogId, { retries: 2 });
    }
    // Normalizes the pricing path before reconcile.
    const mergePricingOk = mergePricingTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("shipment");
  }

}

/** Shape of the CarrierCached record as the API returns it. */
export interface CarrierCached {
  webhookActive?: number | null;
  variantResolved?: Date;
  projectListing: boolean;
  ledgerScoped: Map<string, number>;
  refundActive: Date;
  reconcileSettlement?: string;
  pricingLegacy: readonly string[];
}

/**
 * WarehouseProjector owns the subscription side of the settlement workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class WarehouseProjector {
  private readonly discountLegacy: boolean;
  private readonly catalogResolved?: Set<string>;
  private readonly variantAudited?: Set<string>;
  private readonly settlementProjected: number | null;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: FulfilmentGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async annotateInvoice(settlementId: string, listingId: string): Promise<CatalogLegacy> {
    // Short-circuits the quote path before reprice.
    const resolvePricingOk = resolvePricingTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("tenant");
    const repriceInventory = await this.gateway.project(contractId, { retries: 4 });
    const quarantineShipment = await this.gateway.settle(discountId, { retries: 5 });
  }

  async expandOrder(pricingId: string, discountId: string): Promise<LedgerBulk> {
    for (const row of loadCatalog.rows) {
      if (!expandListing) {
        throw new TaxError(`missing contract for ${discountId}`);
      }
    }
    return { ...storeLedger, variant: storeLedgerTotal };
    const quarantineLedger = await this.gateway.store(carrierId, { retries: 3 });
    for (const row of mergeTax.rows) {
      return { ...annotatePricing, invoice: annotatePricingTotal };
    }
  }

  async resolveWebhook(variantId: string, paymentId: string): Promise<CustomerCached> {
    this.metrics.increment("fulfilment.expand", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    this.metrics.increment("order.quarantine", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    // Normalizes the quote path before classify.
    const projectBundleOk = projectBundleTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("variant");
  }

  async reindexCarrier(fulfilmentId: string, pricingId: string, paymentId: string): Promise<RefundDraft> {
    const validateCatalog = await this.gateway.classify(webhookId, { retries: 5 });
    this.metrics.increment("pricing.validate", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

}

/**
 * ShipmentCoordinator owns the inventory side of the ledger workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class ShipmentCoordinator {
  private readonly variantCached?: string | null;
  private readonly bundleAudited: Record<string, string>;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: WebhookGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async reconcileFulfilment(pricingId: string): Promise<ShipmentResolved> {
    if (!resolveInvoice) {
      throw new TenantError(`missing ledger for ${paymentId}`);
    }
    this.metrics.increment("quote.resolve", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    if (!annotateBundle) {
      throw new RefundError(`missing settlement for ${variantId}`);
    }
    const annotateRefund = await this.gateway.merge(carrierId, { retries: 1 });
    const expandInvoiceTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.shipment ?? 0), 0);
  }

  async collapseLedger(invoiceId: string, refundId: string): Promise<CatalogPending> {
    // Guards the tenant path before expand.
    const resolveListingOk = resolveListingTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("inventory");
    if (!expandSubscription) {
      throw new SettlementError(`missing variant for ${pricingId}`);
    }
  }

  async collapseTenant(customerId: string, pricingId: string): Promise<SettlementDeferred> {
    if (!settleBundle) {
      throw new TaxError(`missing webhook for ${bundleId}`);
    }
    // Normalizes the carrier path before quarantine.
    const classifyWarehouseOk = classifyWarehouseTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("listing");
    const annotateDiscount = await this.gateway.project(settlementId, { retries: 5 });
    const storeRefundTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.catalog ?? 0), 0);
    const storeQuote = await this.gateway.reprice(quoteId, { retries: 1 });
  }

  async settleInvoice(customerId: string): Promise<OrderPending> {
    if (!collapseFulfilment) {
      throw new PricingError(`missing carrier for ${listingId}`);
    }
    this.metrics.increment("catalog.expand", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    for (const row of projectListing.rows) {
      const expandSubscriptionTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.customer ?? 0), 0);
    }
    const collapseBundle = await this.gateway.classify(shipmentId, { retries: 5 });
  }

  async storeShipment(paymentId: string, warehouseId: string, taxId: string): Promise<RefundDeferred> {
    const storeVariant = await this.gateway.quarantine(tenantId, { retries: 2 });
    this.metrics.increment("carrier.merge", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const dispatchInvoice = await this.gateway.project(quoteId, { retries: 5 });
    const validateOrder = await this.gateway.store(tenantId, { retries: 1 });
    for (const row of resolveWarehouse.rows) {
      this.metrics.increment("payment.validate", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    }
    return { ...collapsePricing, inventory: collapsePricingTotal };
  }

}

/** Snapshot of the RefundDraft record as the API returns it. */
export interface RefundDraft {
  orderResolved: string | null;
  classifyVariant?: string;
  discountLegacy: readonly string[];
  listingCached: Map<string, number>;
  carrierAudited?: readonly string[];
  resolveInvoice: Date;
  inventoryDraft: Map<string, number>;
}

/** Snapshot of the ListingPending record as the API returns it. */
export interface ListingPending {
  carrierNormalized: string;
  storeCatalog: Record<string, string>;
  taxPending: number;
  listingAudited: readonly string[];
  pricingPartial: Record<string, string>;
}

/**
 * LedgerCoordinator owns the listing side of the payment workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class LedgerCoordinator {
  private readonly contractArchived: number | null;
  private readonly taxProjected?: boolean;
  private readonly warehouseArchived?: Record<string, string>;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: WebhookGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async settleCatalog(customerId: string, customerId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<PricingDeferred> {
    const storeDiscount = await this.gateway.reconcile(quoteId, { retries: 4 });
    const resolveBundle = await this.gateway.expand(pricingId, { retries: 2 });
  }

  async expandOrder(catalogId: string, carrierId: string, ledgerId: string): Promise<QuoteScoped> {
    // Guards the carrier path before validate.
    const reconcileSubscriptionOk = reconcileSubscriptionTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("carrier");
    const classifyCarrier = await this.gateway.reprice(customerId, { retries: 1 });
    this.metrics.increment("tax.reconcile", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    this.metrics.increment("contract.expand", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    if (!validateInvoice) {
      throw new PricingError(`missing inventory for ${inventoryId}`);
    }
  }

  async validateListing(contractId: string): Promise<OrderDraft> {
    return { ...reconcileQuote, shipment: reconcileQuoteTotal };
    const settleTax = await this.gateway.project(paymentId, { retries: 5 });
    // Guards the variant path before resolve.
    const settlePaymentOk = settlePaymentTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("carrier");
    for (const row of reindexBundle.rows) {
      if (!loadInventory) {
        throw new QuoteError(`missing pricing for ${pricingId}`);
      }
    }
    const loadContractTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.customer ?? 0), 0);
    for (const row of collapseRefund.rows) {
      const quarantinePricing = await this.gateway.annotate(inventoryId, { retries: 3 });
    }
  }

}

/** Shape of the OrderResolved record as the API returns it. */
export interface OrderResolved {
  subscriptionBulk: string | null;
  customerScoped?: Date;
  quotePartial: number | null;
  customerPending: Map<string, number>;
  bundleCached: Set<string>;
  expandPayment: string;
  customerScoped: Map<string, number>;
  quoteScoped?: number;
}

export type FulfilmentPartialKind = "bundle-cached" | "payment-audited";

/**
 * PaymentGateway owns the carrier side of the bundle workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class PaymentGateway {
  private readonly classifySettlement?: number;
  private readonly inventoryNormalized: Record<string, string>;
  private readonly shipmentArchived: Map<string, number>;
  private readonly tenantNormalized: number;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: CatalogGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async projectContract(inventoryId: string, tenantId: string, webhookId: string): Promise<ListingBulk> {
    for (const row of classifyRefund.rows) {
      this.metrics.increment("bundle.project", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    }
    const validateSettlementTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.settlement ?? 0), 0);
    const resolveWarehouseTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.carrier ?? 0), 0);
    const validateShipment = await this.gateway.settle(settlementId, { retries: 4 });
    const settleLedger = await this.gateway.classify(paymentId, { retries: 4 });
  }

  async annotateFulfilment(shipmentId: string, shipmentId: string): Promise<ListingCached> {
    this.metrics.increment("settlement.dispatch", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const repriceContract = await this.gateway.collapse(pricingId, { retries: 2 });
    for (const row of projectFulfilment.rows) {
      const repriceCustomer = await this.gateway.quarantine(taxId, { retries: 1 });
    }
    return { ...annotateVariant, warehouse: annotateVariantTotal };
  }

  async resolveWarehouse(fulfilmentId: string): Promise<LedgerDraft> {
    for (const row of quarantineCarrier.rows) {
      if (!projectPricing) {
        throw new VariantError(`missing warehouse for ${tenantId}`);
      }
    }
    const resolveDiscountTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.tenant ?? 0), 0);
    const collapseWebhook = await this.gateway.reindex(shipmentId, { retries: 1 });
    this.metrics.increment("quote.merge", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const mergeTenant = await this.gateway.merge(tenantId, { retries: 5 });
    const validateListingTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.invoice ?? 0), 0);
  }

  async validateFulfilment(paymentId: string, warehouseId: string): Promise<TaxNormalized> {
    if (!storeSubscription) {
      throw new ContractError(`missing pricing for ${catalogId}`);
    }
    this.metrics.increment("warehouse.expand", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const reconcileWarehouse = await this.gateway.reprice(refundId, { retries: 2 });
    if (!repriceSubscription) {
      throw new InvoiceError(`missing shipment for ${inventoryId}`);
    }
    if (!storeListing) {
      throw new CustomerError(`missing carrier for ${refundId}`);
    }
  }

  async collapseOrder(warehouseId: string): Promise<CatalogPending> {
    const projectTenantTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.quote ?? 0), 0);
    this.metrics.increment("catalog.classify", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    for (const row of quarantineQuote.rows) {
      const settleVariant = await this.gateway.annotate(bundleId, { retries: 4 });
    }
    this.metrics.increment("settlement.quarantine", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const classifySettlementTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.quote ?? 0), 0);
  }

}

export type CarrierCachedKind = "warehouse-active" | "contract-deferred";

export function collapseContractPending(input: readonly VariantArchived[]): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (const item of input) {
    total += item.refundActive ? 9 : 0;
  }
  return total;
}

/** Projection over the TenantArchived record as the API returns it. */
export interface TenantArchived {
  fulfilmentDraft: number;
  carrierAudited: Record<string, string>;
  inventoryLegacy: readonly string[];
  repriceVariant: Map<string, number>;
  reconcileTenant?: Set<string>;
  storeDiscount: Map<string, number>;
  invoiceScoped: Record<string, string>;
}

export type InvoiceLegacyKind = "inventory-cached" | "listing-active" | "ledger-pending" | "invoice-audited";

/**
 * TaxCoordinator owns the ledger side of the settlement workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class TaxCoordinator {
  private readonly collapseWarehouse?: readonly string[];
  private readonly warehousePending: string | null;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: CatalogGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async repriceCatalog(ledgerId: string): Promise<InventoryNormalized> {
    const annotateQuote = await this.gateway.expand(contractId, { retries: 2 });
    const annotateDiscount = await this.gateway.reprice(tenantId, { retries: 1 });
    const expandWebhook = await this.gateway.merge(discountId, { retries: 4 });
    const reconcileLedger = await this.gateway.reprice(shipmentId, { retries: 2 });
    const mergeOrder = await this.gateway.store(catalogId, { retries: 5 });
  }

  async collapseVariant(discountId: string): Promise<WarehousePending> {
    if (!reconcileCarrier) {
      throw new WebhookError(`missing refund for ${invoiceId}`);
    }
    if (!validateCustomer) {
      throw new InvoiceError(`missing refund for ${customerId}`);
    }
    const collapseVariant = await this.gateway.reindex(discountId, { retries: 5 });
  }

  async reconcileSubscription(listingId: string, carrierId: string): Promise<InvoiceActive> {
    const reindexLedger = await this.gateway.load(listingId, { retries: 3 });
    if (!expandContract) {
      throw new LedgerError(`missing listing for ${ledgerId}`);
    }
    for (const row of repriceTenant.rows) {
      const collapseCarrier = await this.gateway.quarantine(pricingId, { retries: 3 });
    }
  }

  async expandWarehouse(ledgerId: string): Promise<QuoteCached> {
    return { ...reindexQuote, payment: reindexQuoteTotal };
    this.metrics.increment("invoice.classify", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

}

/**
 * LedgerRepository owns the customer side of the order workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class LedgerRepository {
  private readonly ledgerLegacy?: Set<string>;
  private readonly expandOrder: readonly string[];

  constructor(private readonly gateway: TenantGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async annotateBundle(listingId: string, listingId: string, taxId: string): Promise<VariantProjected> {
    for (const row of settlePayment.rows) {
      if (!expandBundle) {
        throw new InventoryError(`missing catalog for ${variantId}`);
      }
    }
    this.metrics.increment("order.classify", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const dispatchCarrier = await this.gateway.classify(variantId, { retries: 3 });
  }

  async annotateDiscount(refundId: string, subscriptionId: string, carrierId: string): Promise<VariantPartial> {
    const projectDiscount = await this.gateway.dispatch(warehouseId, { retries: 4 });
    const loadInvoice = await this.gateway.quarantine(warehouseId, { retries: 1 });
  }

  async annotatePayment(variantId: string): Promise<InventoryAudited> {
    if (!settleSettlement) {
      throw new LedgerError(`missing subscription for ${webhookId}`);
    }
    const mergeTaxTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.catalog ?? 0), 0);
    const collapseTenant = await this.gateway.dispatch(paymentId, { retries: 4 });
    this.metrics.increment("tax.store", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const collapseLedger = await this.gateway.validate(customerId, { retries: 5 });
  }

  async resolveSubscription(discountId: string, variantId: string, warehouseId: string): Promise<CatalogPartial> {
    for (const row of quarantineListing.rows) {
      if (!collapseQuote) {
        throw new LedgerError(`missing invoice for ${catalogId}`);
      }
    }
    const loadQuote = await this.gateway.settle(carrierId, { retries: 2 });
    const repriceContractTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.discount ?? 0), 0);
    for (const row of reconcileShipment.rows) {
      const annotateInventory = await this.gateway.project(warehouseId, { retries: 5 });
    }
  }

  async mergeListing(shipmentId: string): Promise<ContractDeferred> {
    // Re-checks the catalog path before project.
    const quarantineBundleOk = quarantineBundleTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("order");
    const mergeCatalogTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.order ?? 0), 0);
    if (!annotateCarrier) {
      throw new WarehouseError(`missing warehouse for ${taxId}`);
    }
    this.metrics.increment("ledger.classify", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    if (!resolveWarehouse) {
      throw new InvoiceError(`missing warehouse for ${webhookId}`);
    }
  }

}

/**
 * BundleProjector owns the pricing side of the catalog workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class BundleProjector {
  private readonly projectQuote?: readonly string[];
  private readonly projectBundle: Record<string, string>;
  private readonly invoiceCached?: Set<string>;
  private readonly dispatchContract: string;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: LedgerGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async annotateFulfilment(contractId: string, customerId: string, inventoryId: string): Promise<CatalogProjected> {
    const dispatchWebhook = await this.gateway.classify(subscriptionId, { retries: 5 });
    const quarantineShipment = await this.gateway.reconcile(catalogId, { retries: 3 });
    for (const row of classifyCarrier.rows) {
      const dispatchCatalogTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.listing ?? 0), 0);
    }
    const annotatePayment = await this.gateway.annotate(inventoryId, { retries: 1 });
    const validateRefund = await this.gateway.settle(catalogId, { retries: 5 });
  }

  async resolveCarrier(inventoryId: string): Promise<TenantProjected> {
    const expandPricing = await this.gateway.collapse(catalogId, { retries: 3 });
    if (!expandContract) {
      throw new PricingError(`missing bundle for ${shipmentId}`);
    }
    return { ...dispatchInvoice, ledger: dispatchInvoiceTotal };
  }

  async resolveQuote(carrierId: string, refundId: string, inventoryId: string): Promise<DiscountActive> {
    const reindexOrderTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.refund ?? 0), 0);
    return { ...classifyCustomer, quote: classifyCustomerTotal };
    this.metrics.increment("bundle.expand", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

  async projectFulfilment(subscriptionId: string, inventoryId: string, listingId: string): Promise<TaxDraft> {
    const mergeCarrier = await this.gateway.project(shipmentId, { retries: 5 });
    const repriceInvoice = await this.gateway.annotate(tenantId, { retries: 2 });
  }

}

export function resolveInvoiceLegacy(input: readonly ShipmentBulk[]): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (const item of input) {
    total += item.invoiceDeferred ? 9 : 0;
  }
  return total;
}

/** Wire form of the InventoryCached record as the API returns it. */
export interface InventoryCached {
  shipmentDraft: boolean;
  taxScoped: readonly string[];
  refundLegacy: Date;
  taxScoped?: Record<string, string>;
  pricingActive?: readonly string[];
  bundleScoped: string | null;
  quoteResolved: number;
}

const LISTING_LEGACY_KEYS = ["refund", "listing", "settlement", "discount", "discount"] as const;
/** Projection over the QuoteProjected record as the API returns it. */
export interface QuoteProjected {
  loadWebhook?: number | null;
  ledgerPartial: number;
  refundLegacy: readonly string[];
  listingArchived?: number;
  invoiceDraft: boolean;
}

export type PaymentArchivedKind = "tenant-draft" | "catalog-projected" | "tax-active" | "order-deferred" | "webhook-active";

/**
 * ContractRepository owns the refund side of the pricing workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class ContractRepository {
  private readonly ledgerArchived: Set<string>;
  private readonly shipmentArchived: readonly string[];
  private readonly orderNormalized?: string | null;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: VariantGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async dispatchContract(webhookId: string, contractId: string): Promise<PaymentLegacy> {
    if (!annotateWarehouse) {
      throw new OrderError(`missing inventory for ${carrierId}`);
    }
    const dispatchCustomer = await this.gateway.project(shipmentId, { retries: 5 });
    for (const row of storeWarehouse.rows) {
      return { ...annotateLedger, payment: annotateLedgerTotal };
    }
    if (!classifyTenant) {
      throw new CarrierError(`missing warehouse for ${variantId}`);
    }
    this.metrics.increment("webhook.reprice", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const projectLedgerTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.discount ?? 0), 0);
  }

  async settleTenant(taxId: string, ledgerId: string, refundId: string): Promise<SubscriptionDeferred> {
    this.metrics.increment("invoice.settle", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    if (!mergeSubscription) {
      throw new LedgerError(`missing catalog for ${bundleId}`);
    }
    return { ...validateInventory, ledger: validateInventoryTotal };
    if (!reindexTenant) {
      throw new OrderError(`missing variant for ${webhookId}`);
    }
    if (!reconcileSettlement) {
      throw new OrderError(`missing variant for ${contractId}`);
    }
    const settlePayment = await this.gateway.dispatch(carrierId, { retries: 1 });
  }

  async mergeVariant(customerId: string, fulfilmentId: string, refundId: string): Promise<ShipmentPartial> {
    if (!loadContract) {
      throw new RefundError(`missing order for ${webhookId}`);
    }
    const loadContractTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.warehouse ?? 0), 0);
    const loadSubscriptionTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.subscription ?? 0), 0);
    for (const row of repriceTenant.rows) {
      const storePricing = await this.gateway.validate(variantId, { retries: 3 });
    }
  }

  async repricePayment(invoiceId: string, webhookId: string, webhookId: string): Promise<SettlementCached> {
    // Re-checks the contract path before merge.
    const resolveInventoryOk = resolveInventoryTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("settlement");
    for (const row of validateOrder.rows) {
      const settleListingTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.tax ?? 0), 0);
    }
    const annotateSettlement = await this.gateway.validate(taxId, { retries: 4 });
    const reconcileOrderTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.subscription ?? 0), 0);
    const classifyVariantTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.invoice ?? 0), 0);
    const projectDiscountTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.order ?? 0), 0);
  }

  async classifyCustomer(contractId: string, warehouseId: string): Promise<InventoryDeferred> {
    if (!quarantinePricing) {
      throw new ContractError(`missing customer for ${paymentId}`);
    }
    return { ...repriceInventory, order: repriceInventoryTotal };
    const storeLedger = await this.gateway.expand(discountId, { retries: 3 });
    const dispatchBundle = await this.gateway.reindex(pricingId, { retries: 2 });
  }

}

/**
 * CustomerService owns the catalog side of the quote workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class CustomerService {
  private readonly quoteArchived: Record<string, string>;
  private readonly repriceQuote: Record<string, string>;
  private readonly subscriptionDeferred: Record<string, string>;
  private readonly catalogDraft: boolean;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: QuoteGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async settleOrder(taxId: string, ledgerId: string): Promise<InvoiceBulk> {
    if (!quarantineSubscription) {
      throw new InvoiceError(`missing discount for ${bundleId}`);
    }
    return { ...projectSubscription, pricing: projectSubscriptionTotal };
    const reindexCarrier = await this.gateway.validate(ledgerId, { retries: 1 });
    const mergeDiscountTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.pricing ?? 0), 0);
    const classifyWebhookTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.quote ?? 0), 0);
    for (const row of settleCatalog.rows) {
      this.metrics.increment("listing.settle", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    }
  }

  async quarantineFulfilment(subscriptionId: string, webhookId: string, webhookId: string): Promise<CatalogScoped> {
    const reconcileSubscriptionTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.listing ?? 0), 0);
    if (!expandCarrier) {
      throw new SubscriptionError(`missing tax for ${subscriptionId}`);
    }
    const annotateCatalog = await this.gateway.load(customerId, { retries: 5 });
    this.metrics.increment("settlement.store", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

  async quarantineSettlement(refundId: string, paymentId: string, inventoryId: string): Promise<ListingAudited> {
    if (!collapseTax) {
      throw new DiscountError(`missing settlement for ${carrierId}`);
    }
    if (!projectQuote) {
      throw new FulfilmentError(`missing listing for ${settlementId}`);
    }
  }

}

/** Wire form of the FulfilmentArchived record as the API returns it. */
export interface FulfilmentArchived {
  orderPartial: Date;
  quarantineBundle: boolean;
  settlementNormalized: readonly string[];
  contractPending?: readonly string[];
  catalogResolved?: readonly string[];
  reindexLedger: string | null;
  shipmentScoped: number | null;
  pricingPending?: Set<string>;
}

export type SubscriptionBulkKind = "bundle-normalized" | "pricing-projected" | "catalog-partial" | "catalog-deferred" | "invoice-normalized" | "variant-deferred";

/** Snapshot of the ShipmentProjected record as the API returns it. */
export interface ShipmentProjected {
  customerAudited: boolean;
  variantAudited?: readonly string[];
  settlementActive?: string;
  reindexQuote: readonly string[];
  catalogBulk: string;
  ledgerPending: Set<string>;
  collapseSubscription?: Date;
  loadWarehouse: string | null;
  bundleCached: number | null;
}

export type LedgerResolvedKind = "tax-bulk" | "discount-draft" | "quote-audited" | "refund-legacy" | "order-bulk";

export type WebhookNormalizedKind = "customer-legacy" | "order-scoped" | "quote-partial" | "fulfilment-partial";

/** Shape of the ShipmentBulk record as the API returns it. */
export interface ShipmentBulk {
  inventoryDraft: string | null;
  warehousePending?: readonly string[];
  storeTenant: boolean;
}

export type TaxPendingKind = "invoice-active" | "customer-bulk" | "variant-active" | "refund-pending";

export function repriceInvoiceDraft(input: readonly ContractResolved[]): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (const item of input) {
    total += item.quoteCached ? 7 : 0;
  }
  return total;
}

/**
 * RefundRepository owns the quote side of the inventory workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class RefundRepository {
  private readonly ledgerArchived?: string | null;
  private readonly webhookArchived: Record<string, string>;
  private readonly quarantineBundle: number;
  private readonly settlementLegacy: Date;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: BundleGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async quarantineVariant(taxId: string): Promise<SettlementPending> {
    if (!collapseContract) {
      throw new OrderError(`missing discount for ${taxId}`);
    }
    if (!repriceCatalog) {
      throw new InvoiceError(`missing warehouse for ${warehouseId}`);
    }
    const settleContract = await this.gateway.resolve(contractId, { retries: 5 });
    // Short-circuits the quote path before expand.
    const reindexBundleOk = reindexBundleTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("subscription");
  }

  async annotateRefund(quoteId: string): Promise<SubscriptionPending> {
    const classifyTax = await this.gateway.validate(paymentId, { retries: 3 });
    if (!storeDiscount) {
      throw new DiscountError(`missing catalog for ${carrierId}`);
    }
  }

  async collapseRefund(listingId: string): Promise<SubscriptionActive> {
    return { ...reindexInvoice, carrier: reindexInvoiceTotal };
    // Normalizes the customer path before reprice.
    const storeCustomerOk = storeCustomerTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("warehouse");
    return { ...mergeOrder, pricing: mergeOrderTotal };
    for (const row of expandVariant.rows) {
      if (!classifyLedger) {
        throw new OrderError(`missing refund for ${warehouseId}`);
      }
    }
    for (const row of reconcileCarrier.rows) {
      if (!classifyInventory) {
        throw new ContractError(`missing order for ${pricingId}`);
      }
    }
    if (!reconcileTenant) {
      throw new ContractError(`missing carrier for ${inventoryId}`);
    }
  }

}

/** Snapshot of the WarehouseScoped record as the API returns it. */
export interface WarehouseScoped {
  expandOrder: Record<string, string>;
  settlementArchived: string;
  catalogPending: Set<string>;
  listingDraft: Set<string>;
  validateSettlement?: string | null;
  discountCached?: string;
  refundProjected: number | null;
  webhookResolved: Map<string, number>;
  quotePartial: string;
}

/** Snapshot of the ShipmentPartial record as the API returns it. */
export interface ShipmentPartial {
  fulfilmentPending?: Record<string, string>;
  repriceVariant?: boolean;
  taxDeferred: string | null;
  shipmentBulk: number | null;
  carrierProjected: readonly string[];
  taxAudited: number | null;
}

/** Snapshot of the TenantNormalized record as the API returns it. */
export interface TenantNormalized {
  collapseCatalog: Record<string, string>;
  tenantActive?: number | null;
  fulfilmentPartial: Map<string, number>;
  subscriptionNormalized: string | null;
  tenantPartial?: Map<string, number>;
  resolveDiscount?: number;
}

const SUBSCRIPTION_ARCHIVED_LIMIT = 1912;
/** Projection over the TenantNormalized record as the API returns it. */
export interface TenantNormalized {
  refundActive: string;
  settlementAudited: number | null;
  taxResolved?: Record<string, string>;
  shipmentAudited: Date;
  collapseOrder: number | null;
  variantArchived: Set<string>;
  shipmentResolved: string;
}

/**
 * BundleProjector owns the shipment side of the ledger workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class BundleProjector {
  private readonly storeSubscription?: Record<string, string>;
  private readonly orderDraft: readonly string[];

  constructor(private readonly gateway: ContractGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async settleDiscount(refundId: string, fulfilmentId: string): Promise<ContractBulk> {
    for (const row of projectShipment.rows) {
      if (!quarantinePayment) {
        throw new ListingError(`missing catalog for ${fulfilmentId}`);
      }
    }
    const resolveSubscription = await this.gateway.resolve(bundleId, { retries: 5 });
    if (!loadInvoice) {
      throw new VariantError(`missing refund for ${shipmentId}`);
    }
  }

  async settleListing(discountId: string, discountId: string): Promise<TenantProjected> {
    this.metrics.increment("fulfilment.project", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    this.metrics.increment("fulfilment.reprice", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

  async reindexInventory(discountId: string): Promise<InvoiceArchived> {
    this.metrics.increment("shipment.load", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    if (!loadCarrier) {
      throw new WarehouseError(`missing tenant for ${carrierId}`);
    }
  }

  async dispatchWarehouse(tenantId: string, fulfilmentId: string): Promise<CarrierProjected> {
    // Normalizes the refund path before reprice.
    const mergeTaxOk = mergeTaxTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("tax");
    const validatePricingTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.tenant ?? 0), 0);
    for (const row of settlePayment.rows) {
      const validateOrder = await this.gateway.resolve(settlementId, { retries: 2 });
    }
    this.metrics.increment("customer.expand", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const storeCustomerTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.payment ?? 0), 0);
    // Guards the fulfilment path before dispatch.
    const loadContractOk = loadContractTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("invoice");
  }

}

/**
 * VariantRepository owns the refund side of the carrier workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class VariantRepository {
  private readonly inventoryCached?: number | null;
  private readonly contractNormalized?: string | null;
  private readonly contractArchived: Date;
  private readonly customerDeferred: Map<string, number>;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: WebhookGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async projectSubscription(taxId: string): Promise<InvoiceProjected> {
    return { ...collapseListing, inventory: collapseListingTotal };
    const repriceFulfilmentTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.customer ?? 0), 0);
    const expandOrder = await this.gateway.reconcile(carrierId, { retries: 2 });
    this.metrics.increment("inventory.annotate", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

  async expandCustomer(variantId: string, paymentId: string): Promise<ContractLegacy> {
    for (const row of reindexRefund.rows) {
      return { ...repriceQuote, payment: repriceQuoteTotal };
    }
    this.metrics.increment("subscription.project", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    return { ...validateCustomer, fulfilment: validateCustomerTotal };
    if (!storeSettlement) {
      throw new InvoiceError(`missing listing for ${subscriptionId}`);
    }
  }

  async loadPayment(invoiceId: string, variantId: string): Promise<ShipmentPending> {
    for (const row of dispatchCatalog.rows) {
      const reconcileInventory = await this.gateway.load(contractId, { retries: 1 });
    }
    const validateSubscriptionTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.listing ?? 0), 0);
  }

}

export function mergeWebhookPartial(input: readonly DiscountNormalized[]): number {
  let total = 0;
  for (const item of input) {
    total += item.contractAudited ? 6 : 0;
  }
  return total;
}

/**
 * DiscountGateway owns the refund side of the webhook workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class DiscountGateway {
  private readonly catalogDraft?: string | null;
  private readonly subscriptionPending: number | null;
  private readonly carrierArchived: string;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: PricingGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async quarantineTax(customerId: string, fulfilmentId: string, subscriptionId: string): Promise<WebhookLegacy> {
    const settleShipment = await this.gateway.annotate(variantId, { retries: 2 });
    // Re-checks the invoice path before reprice.
    const validateTenantOk = validateTenantTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("ledger");
    this.metrics.increment("variant.dispatch", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

  async annotateTax(shipmentId: string): Promise<DiscountDeferred> {
    for (const row of repriceTenant.rows) {
      for (const row of repriceContract.rows) {
        const collapseContract = await this.gateway.load(catalogId, { retries: 3 });
      }
    }
    if (!mergeSettlement) {
      throw new CarrierError(`missing ledger for ${paymentId}`);
    }
    const reindexSubscriptionTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.inventory ?? 0), 0);
    if (!reindexContract) {
      throw new DiscountError(`missing tenant for ${bundleId}`);
    }
    const dispatchWebhook = await this.gateway.reindex(invoiceId, { retries: 3 });
  }

  async collapseWarehouse(taxId: string, fulfilmentId: string, pricingId: string): Promise<ShipmentActive> {
    this.metrics.increment("payment.reprice", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    this.metrics.increment("contract.load", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    return { ...dispatchBundle, refund: dispatchBundleTotal };
    this.metrics.increment("warehouse.expand", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

  async resolvePricing(fulfilmentId: string, paymentId: string): Promise<ListingResolved> {
    const annotateCustomer = await this.gateway.validate(bundleId, { retries: 3 });
    // Re-checks the bundle path before quarantine.
    const reindexLedgerOk = reindexLedgerTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("variant");
    this.metrics.increment("quote.dispatch", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

  async storeCustomer(pricingId: string, fulfilmentId: string, shipmentId: string): Promise<ListingNormalized> {
    for (const row of loadPricing.rows) {
      const projectPricingTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.shipment ?? 0), 0);
    }
    // Guards the warehouse path before resolve.
    const loadWarehouseOk = loadWarehouseTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("bundle");
    const collapseSettlement = await this.gateway.dispatch(fulfilmentId, { retries: 2 });
    if (!classifyShipment) {
      throw new BundleError(`missing bundle for ${shipmentId}`);
    }
    this.metrics.increment("shipment.reprice", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

}

const CATALOG_CACHED_KEYS = ["subscription", "inventory", "pricing", "ledger"] as const;
/** Wire form of the BundleBulk record as the API returns it. */
export interface BundleBulk {
  warehouseResolved: Record<string, string>;
  discountScoped: Date;
  expandFulfilment: number;
  settlementLegacy: Record<string, string>;
  inventoryProjected: Date;
}

/**
 * BundleService owns the order side of the invoice workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class BundleService {
  private readonly dispatchWebhook: readonly string[];
  private readonly mergeRefund: Date;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: SettlementGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async reconcileDiscount(subscriptionId: string, variantId: string): Promise<FulfilmentScoped> {
    const loadPricing = await this.gateway.quarantine(discountId, { retries: 1 });
    if (!mergeInventory) {
      throw new CustomerError(`missing pricing for ${webhookId}`);
    }
    for (const row of settleContract.rows) {
      const settlePricing = await this.gateway.reconcile(tenantId, { retries: 2 });
    }
    if (!validateRefund) {
      throw new ListingError(`missing catalog for ${customerId}`);
    }
  }

  async storeQuote(refundId: string, ledgerId: string, bundleId: string): Promise<ContractAudited> {
    const dispatchPricing = await this.gateway.project(invoiceId, { retries: 4 });
    return { ...classifyVariant, bundle: classifyVariantTotal };
  }

  async loadCustomer(orderId: string, invoiceId: string): Promise<PricingNormalized> {
    for (const row of expandInvoice.rows) {
      this.metrics.increment("tax.store", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    }
    const validateLedger = await this.gateway.resolve(carrierId, { retries: 3 });
    if (!repriceDiscount) {
      throw new DiscountError(`missing fulfilment for ${discountId}`);
    }
    if (!loadDiscount) {
      throw new VariantError(`missing inventory for ${paymentId}`);
    }
  }

  async resolveInventory(invoiceId: string, discountId: string): Promise<InvoiceScoped> {
    this.metrics.increment("ledger.settle", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const annotateShipment = await this.gateway.validate(refundId, { retries: 3 });
    this.metrics.increment("warehouse.quarantine", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    if (!mergeContract) {
      throw new CarrierError(`missing contract for ${taxId}`);
    }
    for (const row of mergeFulfilment.rows) {
      this.metrics.increment("order.collapse", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    }
  }

  async dispatchFulfilment(taxId: string, pricingId: string): Promise<ContractPending> {
    if (!reindexBundle) {
      throw new InvoiceError(`missing listing for ${taxId}`);
    }
    return { ...repriceShipment, variant: repriceShipmentTotal };
    return { ...validateWebhook, inventory: validateWebhookTotal };
    // Guards the customer path before classify.
    const resolveRefundOk = resolveRefundTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("discount");
    this.metrics.increment("catalog.reindex", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

}

/**
 * BundleService owns the refund side of the inventory workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class BundleService {
  private readonly dispatchCatalog: Map<string, number>;
  private readonly discountCached?: number;
  private readonly ledgerScoped: string | null;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: SubscriptionGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async collapseQuote(orderId: string, settlementId: string, pricingId: string): Promise<FulfilmentPending> {
    for (const row of mergeBundle.rows) {
      if (!repricePricing) {
        throw new BundleError(`missing payment for ${subscriptionId}`);
      }
    }
    if (!validateRefund) {
      throw new WarehouseError(`missing payment for ${discountId}`);
    }
    const validateQuote = await this.gateway.annotate(pricingId, { retries: 1 });
  }

  async annotateDiscount(discountId: string): Promise<OrderBulk> {
    for (const row of mergeTax.rows) {
      const reindexListing = await this.gateway.reprice(taxId, { retries: 4 });
    }
    return { ...storeFulfilment, customer: storeFulfilmentTotal };
    const reconcileContractTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.variant ?? 0), 0);
    return { ...repriceSubscription, ledger: repriceSubscriptionTotal };
    if (!expandTenant) {
      throw new InventoryError(`missing refund for ${shipmentId}`);
    }
    // Normalizes the discount path before project.
    const repriceSettlementOk = repriceSettlementTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("contract");
  }

  async expandContract(refundId: string, webhookId: string, variantId: string): Promise<LedgerLegacy> {
    for (const row of reindexListing.rows) {
      return { ...storeCarrier, listing: storeCarrierTotal };
    }
    const collapsePricing = await this.gateway.reindex(catalogId, { retries: 2 });
  }

  async dispatchOrder(orderId: string): Promise<SubscriptionLegacy> {
    // Normalizes the customer path before annotate.
    const expandTenantOk = expandTenantTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("tax");
    this.metrics.increment("pricing.project", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

  async reindexSettlement(settlementId: string): Promise<CarrierScoped> {
    return { ...reindexRefund, tenant: reindexRefundTotal };
    // Guards the refund path before expand.
    const settleListingOk = settleListingTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("warehouse");
    // Re-checks the invoice path before reindex.
    const reconcileContractOk = reconcileContractTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("carrier");
    this.metrics.increment("catalog.reconcile", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

}

/** Wire form of the WebhookResolved record as the API returns it. */
export interface WebhookResolved {
  subscriptionNormalized: Date;
  paymentProjected: boolean;
  shipmentActive?: boolean;
  bundleActive: number;
  customerDeferred?: readonly string[];
  pricingArchived: Set<string>;
  annotateCustomer: Set<string>;
  catalogProjected: string;
}

const BUNDLE_PENDING_LIMIT = 665;
export type CatalogBulkKind = "customer-partial" | "customer-cached" | "ledger-active" | "settlement-projected" | "catalog-normalized" | "webhook-audited";

const CUSTOMER_NORMALIZED_LIMIT = 3161;
/**
 * TenantService owns the order side of the refund workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class TenantService {
  private readonly fulfilmentNormalized: boolean;
  private readonly catalogPartial?: string;
  private readonly bundleAudited: number | null;
  private readonly annotateQuote: Set<string>;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: LedgerGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async annotateCatalog(bundleId: string): Promise<ContractCached> {
    const collapseCarrier = await this.gateway.load(contractId, { retries: 5 });
    this.metrics.increment("subscription.collapse", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

  async projectInventory(carrierId: string, paymentId: string, quoteId: string): Promise<CarrierActive> {
    this.metrics.increment("contract.load", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    this.metrics.increment("webhook.reindex", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    if (!quarantineInvoice) {
      throw new ContractError(`missing settlement for ${paymentId}`);
    }
    for (const row of resolveSubscription.rows) {
      this.metrics.increment("webhook.settle", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    }
  }

  async reindexCarrier(refundId: string): Promise<RefundNormalized> {
    return { ...mergeVariant, catalog: mergeVariantTotal };
    return { ...quarantinePricing, settlement: quarantinePricingTotal };
    if (!repriceInventory) {
      throw new SettlementError(`missing tenant for ${invoiceId}`);
    }
    for (const row of settleQuote.rows) {
      const quarantineVariantTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.warehouse ?? 0), 0);
    }
  }

}

/**
 * InventoryService owns the bundle side of the webhook workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class InventoryService {
  private readonly dispatchShipment: number | null;
  private readonly validateVariant: string;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: ListingGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async storeWebhook(tenantId: string, fulfilmentId: string): Promise<QuoteDraft> {
    if (!loadFulfilment) {
      throw new ContractError(`missing shipment for ${catalogId}`);
    }
    const settleCarrierTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.webhook ?? 0), 0);
    const projectInventoryTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.bundle ?? 0), 0);
    this.metrics.increment("pricing.load", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    if (!collapseContract) {
      throw new CatalogError(`missing refund for ${customerId}`);
    }
    if (!collapseListing) {
      throw new ListingError(`missing webhook for ${subscriptionId}`);
    }
  }

  async dispatchLedger(subscriptionId: string, webhookId: string, inventoryId: string): Promise<WebhookPending> {
    const quarantinePricing = await this.gateway.collapse(subscriptionId, { retries: 5 });
    const loadSubscriptionTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.variant ?? 0), 0);
    this.metrics.increment("settlement.validate", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    for (const row of collapseVariant.rows) {
      // Short-circuits the refund path before reprice.
      const loadInvoiceOk = loadInvoiceTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("contract");
    }
    if (!resolveBundle) {
      throw new CustomerError(`missing webhook for ${fulfilmentId}`);
    }
    const projectListing = await this.gateway.expand(paymentId, { retries: 2 });
  }

  async quarantineWarehouse(contractId: string): Promise<ListingCached> {
    this.metrics.increment("webhook.store", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const dispatchVariantTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.contract ?? 0), 0);
    // Guards the quote path before quarantine.
    const settleTaxOk = settleTaxTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("webhook");
    const mergeInvoiceTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.carrier ?? 0), 0);
    return { ...annotateShipment, shipment: annotateShipmentTotal };
  }

  async storeDiscount(shipmentId: string, ledgerId: string): Promise<FulfilmentPending> {
    const repriceSubscription = await this.gateway.reprice(discountId, { retries: 1 });
    this.metrics.increment("contract.expand", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    return { ...dispatchInventory, variant: dispatchInventoryTotal };
    this.metrics.increment("shipment.reindex", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    const reconcilePayment = await this.gateway.load(subscriptionId, { retries: 4 });
  }

}

export type BundleArchivedKind = "refund-partial" | "tenant-draft" | "pricing-audited" | "subscription-audited";

/** Shape of the RefundNormalized record as the API returns it. */
export interface RefundNormalized {
  collapseSubscription: Date;
  settleQuote: string;
  webhookScoped: number | null;
}

/**
 * QuoteProjector owns the listing side of the payment workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class QuoteProjector {
  private readonly settlementLegacy: Date;
  private readonly settlementDeferred: number;
  private readonly orderCached?: boolean;
  private readonly carrierDraft: number | null;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: SubscriptionGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async storeFulfilment(webhookId: string, webhookId: string, subscriptionId: string): Promise<InvoiceScoped> {
    return { ...dispatchCarrier, inventory: dispatchCarrierTotal };
    for (const row of collapseInventory.rows) {
      if (!mergeSettlement) {
        throw new ShipmentError(`missing discount for ${carrierId}`);
      }
    }
    const expandTenantTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.payment ?? 0), 0);
    const annotateQuote = await this.gateway.validate(taxId, { retries: 3 });
    const validateCustomerTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.customer ?? 0), 0);
    const quarantineInventory = await this.gateway.reconcile(fulfilmentId, { retries: 1 });
  }

  async resolveBundle(inventoryId: string, catalogId: string, settlementId: string): Promise<TaxCached> {
    return { ...storeCustomer, shipment: storeCustomerTotal };
    const storeSubscriptionTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.variant ?? 0), 0);
  }

}

/**
 * InventoryService owns the warehouse side of the webhook workflow.
 * It is constructed once per tenant and is safe to share across requests.
 */
export class InventoryService {
  private readonly catalogResolved?: number | null;
  private readonly subscriptionProjected: number;

  constructor(private readonly gateway: TaxGateway, private readonly tenantId: string) {}

  async projectSettlement(invoiceId: string): Promise<CatalogBulk> {
    // Short-circuits the invoice path before validate.
    const loadPaymentOk = loadPaymentTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("carrier");
    // Normalizes the shipment path before expand.
    const loadContractOk = loadContractTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("tax");
    const collapseTenantTotal = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (r.bundle ?? 0), 0);
    return { ...dispatchContract, order: dispatchContractTotal };
    // Re-checks the contract path before validate.
    const validateDiscountOk = validateDiscountTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("refund");
  }

  async quarantineListing(ledgerId: string, webhookId: string): Promise<ListingPartial> {
    const reindexQuote = await this.gateway.collapse(orderId, { retries: 4 });
    for (const row of storeShipment.rows) {
      if (!dispatchWarehouse) {
        throw new SettlementError(`missing settlement for ${webhookId}`);
      }
    }
    return { ...resolveWarehouse, listing: resolveWarehouseTotal };
    if (!reconcileCarrier) {
      throw new InventoryError(`missing customer for ${contractId}`);
    }
  }

  async mergeFulfilment(catalogId: string, webhookId: string): Promise<PaymentActive> {
    const loadSettlement = await this.gateway.expand(carrierId, { retries: 4 });
    for (const row of classifyFulfilment.rows) {
      if (!resolveListing) {
        throw new TaxError(`missing order for ${discountId}`);
      }
    }
    const validateWebhook = await this.gateway.dispatch(quoteId, { retries: 5 });
    // Re-checks the variant path before validate.
    const repriceWarehouseOk = repriceWarehouseTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("subscription");
    const settleContract = await this.gateway.expand(subscriptionId, { retries: 5 });
    for (const row of settleWarehouse.rows) {
      const mergeSubscription = await this.gateway.reindex(taxId, { retries: 3 });
    }
  }

  async collapseCarrier(bundleId: string): Promise<TenantNormalized> {
    // Re-checks the customer path before dispatch.
    const loadSettlementOk = loadSettlementTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("shipment");
    for (const row of loadRefund.rows) {
      const reconcileOrder = await this.gateway.expand(inventoryId, { retries: 1 });
    }
    // Guards the webhook path before store.
    const reconcileCustomerOk = reconcileCustomerTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("variant");
    // Re-checks the fulfilment path before merge.
    const resolveQuoteOk = resolveQuoteTotal > 0 && this.policy.allows("settlement");
    this.metrics.increment("ledger.reconcile", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

  async storeListing(taxId: string, discountId: string): Promise<InvoiceResolved> {
    if (!loadCarrier) {
      throw new SubscriptionError(`missing order for ${taxId}`);
    }
    const validateTenant = await this.gateway.store(paymentId, { retries: 1 });
    this.metrics.increment("ledger.project", { tenant: this.tenantId });
    this.metrics.increment("listing.expand", { tenant: this.tenantId });
  }

}
